facts.fact: 1954 年 Bath：她要拆常春藤他不许——「这对照概括了他的婚姻」；婚姻=最大失望+最大失败
facts.anchor: It was his greatest disappointment, and his greatest failure.

facts.fact: Delia 37 岁、Bash 名园主妇、社交海报女郎；他厌倦 war hero 标签下的剪彩差事
facts.anchor: looking like a poster girl for the marriage everyone should aspire to

facts.fact: 订婚时他明说不适合当丈夫（不懂分享自己）；Delia 母女不信；岳父一句「她会收拾你」+Scotch 打发
朋友事后揭底：Elva 母女早锁定他——打听到底细后说「Perfect for our Delia」
婚礼致辞时他自觉是旁观者：连求婚是谁开口都存疑；若由他做主宁可 Gretna Green 私奔再往苏格兰高地蜜月
facts.anchor: Had he even asked Delia to marry him, or had it been the other way around?

facts.fact: 蜜月夜首战起因=她忘带洗漱包求折返被他拒；她罚他睡地板；他被指 ruined the night
facts.anchor: You can sleep on the floor.

facts.fact: 香水 Etourdissant 因此从未送出，收进阁楼 RAF trunk；「快乐妻子=安静生活」成为婚姻准则
facts.anchor: put the gift away in his old RAF trunk

facts.fact: 翻找旧笔记本时发现那瓶香水：一闻——Valentina Camilleri 闪进脑海；马耳他+Caravaggio+她缠在同一缕香里
facts.anchor: it was Valentina Camilleri who flashed into his mind

facts.fact: 他在 Courtauld Institute 任高职（Blunt 上任次年聘他）；Delia 只爱「Fox 太太」的头衔与名流请柬
facts.anchor: She only loved what being his wife could bring her.

facts.fact: 「What if you wanted love」排比：雷击般的爱、上瘾、离不开——Fox 婚姻经不起这套审视
facts.anchor: Well, the Fox marriage couldn’t withstand that sort of scrutiny.

facts.fact: 内心声音逼宫：撕毁契约、提离婚——她不会放？会的，一旦她知道你握有 Gordon Stapleton 的把柄
facts.anchor: Once she realises that you know about Gordon Stapleton.
